$comment: npm audit allowlist for production dependencies (security.yml -> .github/scripts/audit-gate.mjs). Each entry silences ONE advisory (GHSA id) for ONE package until `expires` (max 120 days ahead). After that date the gate fails again. Add an entry only with a reason (why it is not exploitable here or why there is no fix) and an owner who removes it. Runtime libraries with a fix available (e.g. nodemailer) are never allowlisted: upgrade them. Owner of this file: devops-engineer; approvals in docs/reviews/devops-p1-01.md.
